algorithm: Check that the graph has exactly n-1 edges
Check that the graph is connected
If both conditions hold, return True; otherwise, return False
constraints: Edges are distinct and unordered pairs with u < v
The graph must be simple (no multiple edges or self-loops)
The graph may contain isolated vertices
edge_cases: n=1: single vertex with no edges (tree)
n=2: two vertices with one edge (tree)
n=3: three vertices with two edges (tree) or three edges (not tree)
inputs: n: integer >= 1; edges: list of distinct [u,v] pairs where 0<=u<v<n
output: bool: True if the graph is a tree (connected and acyclic), False otherwise
purpose: Determine if a simple undirected graph with n vertices and given edges is a tree
